title: Coiled Dragon Cat Pendant
description: A highly detailed fantasy creature resembling a cat-dragon hybrid is curled into a tight circular ball at the center of the image. It has green and orange scales, fiery orange fur accents, glowing yellow eyes, and holds a small ornate object in its front paws while pink smoke emanates from its mouth. A thick braided rope with a golden clasp and black bead is attached to the top of its head, suggesting it is a pendant or charm.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy creature that is a hybrid between a cat and a dragon, curled into a perfect tight circle like a pendant. It has vibrant green scales with orange fiery edges, orange fur on its head and paws, glowing yellow eyes, visible sharp claws, and pink smoke curling from its mouth. A thick ornate braided rope with golden metal clasp and black bead is attached to the top of its head. Dramatic lighting, textured dark cracked blue background, intricate scales and details, in the style of a realistic fantasy painting.
